text:
martha.cs: Quick async check-in — what I did: followed up with Kestrel Renewal, locked a tentative demo slot; chased adoption blockers for webhook delivery. Blockers: staging still shows duplicate webhook events on retries, customer wants demo but we need stability. Today: coordinate demo + validate staging after patch. @ryan-eng can you take a look at the retry behavior?

ryan-eng: Saw this earlier, looks like idempotency header isn't honored in the retry path. I'll open a small PR to add x-idempotency guard + a short circuit for duplicate event IDs. ETA today.

martha.cs: sample minimal payload below that reproduced duplicates for me: ```{"event_id":"evt_2026-01","user_id":"u_456","type":"message","payload":{}}``` — duplicates occur when client retries within 300ms.

maria-cs: repro steps from my side: used curl loop, sometimes 2 events show up in the app. Will retest after PR. @martha.cs can you share the curl snippet if needed?

ryan-eng: PR created: https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/4876 — adds header check + in-memory short TTL cache for recent event_ids. Also added unit tests for the dedupe logic. Please review when you can.

sam-sre: Heads up — there's a staging deploy window at 15:30 UTC that should include this PR if merged before the cutoff. If merged after, we can do a fast-track. @ryan-eng please add the feature-flag gate.

ryan-eng: Added feature flag `event_dedupe_v1` and feature flag docs snippet. Pushed a follow-up commit for the flag.

mike-cs: Renewal note: I updated the AcmeFin renewal doc with the contingency timeline in case we need to postpone demo. Sharing with AEs after staging verification.

deploy-bot: deploy started for staging at 1765432175.

martha.cs: thanks — pinging support and AE that deploy is in progress :thumbsup: If staging passes, I'll move demo to Tuesday.

ryan-eng: Merged to staging at 1765432185 and added a short-lived metric `webhook.duplicates` so we can monitor.

maria-cs: Verified in staging at 1765432188 — sent 20 rapid retries, no duplicates observed. Filed quick test notes in the ticket.

martha.cs: blocker cleared, thank you all. Today I'll update the renewal playbook, prep the demo deck, and follow up with AE. @sam-sre can you watch logs for the next hour?

sam-sre: on it, I'll post if anything spikes.
